about: Rocks and Gold (jewellery). Each case: a product by its title, patterns one of its kept tags must match (expect) and patterns none may match (reject: the negative cases, such as an emerald cut read as an emerald, or a yellow sapphire read as blue). Patterns are matched against the tag's group and tag names ("אבן חן: רובי"), its English name, key and other words. Facts taken from the titles alone. Reviewed by hand, 20.10.2026.
